items.name: 10 degree wedge backboard with iPad insertion channel
items.selection_reason: Single printed 10 degree wedge with R3 exterior and small pocket edge fillets and 0.5 mm bottom chamfer. iPad insertion channel has NO chamfers or fillets: nominal width along slope 10 mm, normal depth 8 mm, bottom forward offset 4.618802 mm, rearward inclination 20 degrees. Small pocket depth and left margin remain 7 mm for R3.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
